tithiCalculator.title: Tithi Calculator
tithiCalculator.infoButtonTitle: Click for more information about Tithi Calculator
tithiCalculator.aboutDescription1: The Tithi Calculator computes the lunar day (Tithi) in the Hindu calendar. Tithi is determined by the angular distance between the Moon and Sun in the ecliptic plane.
tithiCalculator.aboutDescription2: Modern (Drik): Uses high-precision ephemeris data via the astronomy-engine library (Don Cross), validated against NASA JPL Horizons. This corresponds to the physical reality of the planets.
tithiCalculator.description: Select a date and time to calculate Tithi using modern high-precision astronomy (Drik Ganita).
tithiCalculator.noteText: Calculations use the "astronomy-engine" library for high-precision ephemeris data (Apparent Geocentric Ecliptic of Date).
tithiCalculator.modernAstronomyText: Uses the actual physical positions of the Sun and Moon, computed with VSOP87 planetary theory (thousands of gravitational perturbations), validated against NASA JPL Horizons data.
tithiCalculator.selectValidDateTime: Please select a valid date and time.
